verdict.rationale: Bank reconciliation is a fair axis for accounting software like Moneybird, but the evidence pack never documents reconciling bank accounts against the ledger or surfacing matched, unmatched or duplicate transactions. The only duplicate detection cited covers contacts, not bank transactions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review
